name: EnergyIsolationLotoManager
tagline: Isolation points, group lockbox, personal locks, try-test and shift handover – one drop-in Power Apps component.
description: Complete lockout-tagout app for mines and heavy industry: isolation certificates with points in sequence, group lockbox and personal locks, try-test gate before work, shift-change transfer of the isolation holder, reverse de-isolation and an isolation register – with demo data, Power Fx outputs and events.
features: Rule-checked LOTO lifecycle with automatic moves
Points by energy source in isolation sequence
Group lockbox with capacity and personal locks on/off
Try-test (test for dead) before workers lock on
Shift handover with checks and transfer log
Bulk set holder, print danger tags, CSV export
